speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) safeguards Singapore's safety and security by maintaining a high level of operational excellence and readiness, building new capabilities to meet emerging and evolving threats, and leveraging both community and international partnerships.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The international drug situation continues to be of concern, with the emergence of new psychoactive substances, and more countries adopting a liberal stance towards drug use.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Domestically, it remains imperative to ensure racial and religious harmony for the sake of our country’s peace and prosperity, given the make-up of our society.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Since the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic, MHA has been actively involved in the Whole-of-Government effort to contain the virus, deploying our officers and resources at the frontline, including at the borders and quarantine facilities.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: MHA will also continue to help coordinate the Government's response to the pandemic through its chairmanship of the Homefront Crisis Executive Group (HCEG).

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The HCEG supports the Multi-Ministry Taskforce in planning and executing national policies and responses for COVID-19.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: With the local community transmission situation stabilising, the Government is taking steps to gradually re-open our borders through various travel schemes with other countries.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: To support this, MHA has set up a Safe Travel Office (STO) under the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA), to provide a single touch-point for all travellers, and also provide coordination across the many agencies involved in the various travel schemes.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The STO will make for an easier and smoother traveller experience.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Home Team Science & Technology Agency (HTX) will put its technological capabilities and scientific expertise to use in the fight against the virus.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Currently, travellers at our land, air, and sea borders are screened using HTX's in-house designed test kit, with swab samples analysed at HTX's laboratory.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Travellers are able to obtain their results by the next day.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: In addition, technology such as unmanned aerial vehicles, patrol robots, and remote sensors are being deployed for monitoring of key facilities to better detect crowding and ensure safe distancing.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: As we gradually resume more activities, our police officers will continue to assist safe distancing ambassadors to ensure compliance with safe distancing measures and requirements, as well as to support the Ministry of Health in contact tracing.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: MHA will continue to enhance our capabilities to deal with emerging and evolving threats.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will strengthen our legislation and regulatory regimes.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will review our drug laws to enhance deterrence and strengthen enforcement, including to deal with the rising threat of new psychoactive substances.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will leverage technology to build a stronger Home Team so that we can better protect Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will develop more digital forensics capabilities to tackle technology crimes.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will continue to build up our network of sensors, and use analytics to detect, deter, and solve crimes faster and more effectively.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Robots and Unmanned Autonomous Vehicles (UAVs) will play a greater role in search-and-rescue, fire-fighting, and hazardous materials operations.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will make greater use of automation and video analytics to enhance safety and security in the prisons.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We continue to strengthen our collaboration and operational effectiveness as one Home Team.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will develop more joint operations plans and conduct more joint exercises.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will build more joint capabilities, including in the areas of command, control and communications, and logistics and other support functions.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will strengthen collaboration and deepen expertise across all parts of our Home Team.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We are building a Home Team Operations Centre, which will be an integrated 24/7 coordination hub to manage and monitor Home Team operations more effectively.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will enhance service delivery to the public with more convenient service touchpoints and platforms.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: For example, ICA will set up an Integrated Services Centre to offer one-stop services to the public, to achieve our "3N" vision of "No Fuss, No Visit, and No Waiting".

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Customers can expect efficient and fuss-free services, without having to make a trip to ICA for most transactions.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will also build up the capacity of SCDF's Emergency Medical Services to deliver better emergency response outcomes while meeting growing demand.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will continue to invest in our people.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will equip Home Team officers with skills and knowledge to meet future challenges.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We are leveraging simulation training with realistic scenarios for officers to develop competencies in a safe environment.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Ops-Tech career track will allow us to nurture uniformed officers grounded in operations and proficient in technology.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Terrorist and militant groups continue to be active, and ISIS' propaganda remain widely available online and continue to have a radicalising influence.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: It is thus important that we build up our people's resilience against the threat of terrorism.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: In this regard, we will deepen the community's participation in our safety and security efforts through the SGSecure movement.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Central Narcotics Bureau will work with the community to sharpen preventive drug education efforts.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Singapore Prison Service and Yellow Ribbon Singapore (YRSG) will expand community correction efforts to better support the rehabilitation and reintegration of ex-offenders.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: They will also step up collaboration with community partners to help ex-offenders through training and employment assistance.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Together with Singaporeans, the Home Team will continue to ensure that Singapore remains a safe and secure home for all of us.
